title: Take the countable reduced free amalgam over the compatible wires

---

Apply the countable tracial amalgam theorem to the supplied compatible
packet wires.  Its canonical embeddings retain every leg and its trace; the
GNS closure is one simultaneous exact model.  With a pre-existing common
Hilbert assignment, the universal property of the union presentation gives
the same conclusion directly.
